# Every file in nightjar/ and rubylight-native-api/ that names a licence,
# a copyright or a notice (check-licence-mentions.sh reads them), and what
# covers it in the notices of what ships nightjar-core: the title of the
# notices part that carries its licence, or `-` when the word names no
# licence of the file's code. nightjar/protocol/vendor/rusty_enet/ is left
# out: it is a crate, and cargo-about lists its licence. A new mention fails
# the notices' build until a person reads it and adds its line here.
#
# FILE                                              PART
